messages:
rachel-se: FinSecure raised two blockers: must have HSM-backed KMS + VPC-only handling for PII. Also reported intermittent slow TTFT during an internal demo. Need eng/ops triage and a short pricing note for a dedicated trial.
tom-eng: can you paste the runtime snippet and model/request shape? Long system prompt or many short ones?
sam-cs: customer sent this: ```
POST /v1/stream auth=token
{"model":"rwd-gen-xlarge","prompt":"<long policy doc>","max_tokens":400,"stream":true}
RUNTIME: req=rs_91b2
RUNTIME_LOG: batch_size=1, batch_tokens=620, kv_cache_hit=false
RUNTIME_LOG: cache_evictions=14, kv_cache_ttl=25000ms
RUNTIME_LOG: first_token_ms=1608, avg_token_ms=26
RUNTIME_LOG: quota_event: transient.quota_exhausted
```
priya-ops: quick read: batch_tokens 620 > tenant max_batch_tokens -> single-item scheduling. Small kv_cache_ttl causes evictions between turns. Burst credits low -> transient quota_exhausted under concurrency.
tom-eng: checked config: tenant finsecure had legacy batching.max_batch_tokens=128 while global is 512. Also burst_credits=50. Ops can override.
priya-ops: applying safe overrides: batching.max_batch_tokens=1024 and kv_cache_ttl_ms=180000 for tenant=finsecure. Enabling batch-assembly traces in eu-central-1. override_id=ovr_339a at 2026-04-02T14:12:09Z.
kms-bot: FinSecure requested HSM attestation docs. Internal link: /console/security/kms#hsm-attest. Runbook kms-run-78 created for legal.
tom-eng: notes: 1) HSM KMS shouldn't add inference latency (key unwrap cached). 2) main TTFT causes are batching + cache. Recommend SE warmup with 32-token requests and moving static policy into KV prefix entries. 3) Dedicated reserved pool recommended for demo stability (removes burst contention).
rachel-se: pricing ask: what's delta for a 1-week reserved trial vs pay-as-you-go with temporary burst pool?
priya-ops: ops can propose a 1-week reserved slot sized at 2x nominal throughput + daily cap. Ballpark add-on $3,000 + committed per-token rate. Will loop in Pricing.
sam-cs: customer reran after override: median first_token ~420ms, occasional ~650ms at 8-seat concurrency, no further quota_exhausted. They still need KMS docs for contract.
priya-ops: rollback plan: keep overrides for 48h then review. If they commit to Dedicated we'll set defaults on commit.
tom-eng: leaving traces for 72h. If single-item batches persist, we'll instrument merge heuristics.
rachel-se: shared runbook and KMS docs with FinSecure. Will request formal pricing. Closing when legal confirms KMS attestation accepted. :white_check_mark:
